title: KKR and GIP buy CyrusOne for $15B

sources.quote: today announced the completion of its acquisition by funds managed by KKR, a leading global investment firm, and Global Infrastructure Partners ("GIP"), one of the world's leading infrastructure investors, in an all-cash transaction valued at approximately $15 billion, including the assumption of debt (the "Transaction").

explain: KKR and Global Infrastructure Partners (now part of BlackRock) bought data center operator CyrusOne for about $15 billion including debt; the deal closed in March 2022. The full price is shown on this KKR record.
